name: Schmigadoon!
description: Josh and Melissa are a struggling couple whose lives are transformed when they get trapped in a magical musical town—with a mission they must complete.

videos.title: Schmigadoon!
videos.overview: Melissa and Josh stumble upon the strange musical town of Schmigadoon—and are shocked to learn they can't leave until they find true love.

videos.title: Lovers' Spat
videos.overview: After realizing that they can't leave together, Josh and Melissa break up and start looking for romance around town.

videos.title: Cross That Bridge
videos.overview: When their first flings end in regret, Melissa and Josh agree to a new plan—which he immediately casts aside, prompting her to make a fresh start.

videos.title: Suddenly
videos.overview: Melissa grapples with her conflicted feelings for Doc Lopez, rebelling against his archaic ideas, while Josh tries to court Emma the schoolmarm.

videos.title: Tribulation
videos.overview: New romances hit roadblocks as Melissa meets someone unexpected and Emma reveals a secret. Mildred seizes a chance to increase her power.

videos.title: How We Change
videos.overview: With the election looming, Mildred relentlessly ramps up her campaign. Josh and Melissa face their true feelings for each other.

videos.title: Welcome to Schmicago
videos.overview: Feeling joyless in the real world, Josh and Melissa attempt to return to Schmigadoon but instead find themselves in the darker world of Schmicago.

videos.title: Doorway to Where
videos.overview: As Josh makes a new friend in jail, Melissa hires a lawyer and goes undercover to clear his name.

videos.title: Bells and Whistles
videos.overview: While Josh spends time on the run with Topher and the tribe, Melissa explores Schmicago looking for clues and uncovers a family secret.

videos.title: Something Real
videos.overview: After Josh and Melissa realize they need to find a happy ending for everyone, they try to make that happen—with unintended consequences.

videos.title: Famous as Hell
videos.overview: Convinced they're well on their way to a happy ending, Josh and Melissa both rocket to fame in Schmicago and get embroiled in a deadly plot.

videos.title: Over and Done
videos.overview: Will there be a happy ending? Josh and Melissa are presented with a life-changing choice.

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 10 wins & 36 nominations total
